Description: Registers a new NF, SCP, or SEPP Instance in the NRF.
Deregisters an NF, SCP, or SEPP Instance from the NRF.
Retrieves the NF Profile of a given NF, SCP, or SEPP Instance.
Retrieves a list of NF, SCP, or SEPP Instances currently registered in the NRF.
Registers a new NF Instance in the NRF.
Removes the profile of a Network Function previously registered in the NRF.
Creates a subscription for notifications on NF Instances.
Notifies subscribed NF or SCP Instances of changes on the status of NF or SEPP Instances.
Removes an existing subscription to notifications.
Retrieves a list of NF Instances currently registered in NRF.
Retrieves the profile of a given NF instance currently registered in NRF.
